instructions: Wash the cucumbers and cut them into small cubes, about 1/3 inch. Set them aside.
Peel the garlic clove. Crush it on a cutting board with 3/4 tsp salt, pressing with the side of a knife, until it's a paste.
Whisk 2 cups yogurt in a large bowl until smooth.
Whisk in the garlic paste and 1 tsp dried mint. Add the cucumbers and stir.
If it's too thick, stir in water 1 tbsp at a time, up to 1/4 cup. Chill it for 15 minutes if you have time.
Chop 1 tbsp of the fresh mint and scatter it over the top. Warm the pita in a dry pan or the toaster and cut it into wedges.
method_notes: No version of this dish had 20 or more ratings, so this is a fallback lead: Sweet and Savoury Pursuits (4.91 from 11 ratings), cubed cucumber in yogurt with garlic crushed with salt, dried mint and fresh mint on top. Alphafoodie (4.8 from 10 ratings) agrees on the base but uses crushed garlic stirred in and offers a salting step for the cucumber. Sofra Beirut grates the cucumber, squeezes it dry and uses thick yogurt or labneh with no water, and Mama's Lebanese Kitchen thins the yogurt more with water. This follows the lead and adds the pita from the brief.
